topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture series and outlines the core learning outcomes on cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal selection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages to cells during early tumor development.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchies and cell of origin in tumor development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the cancer stem cell model and present experimental evidence for stem cell hierarchies and cell-of-origin dynamics in leukemia and colorectal cancer.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion and stromal dependence in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how environmental promoters, inflammatory signaling, and supportive stroma enable mutant cells to progress into invasive malignancies.

topics.label: Technologies for investigating tumor evolution and plasticity
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines experimental and computational techniques used to map mutational timing, cell plasticity, and microenvironmental interactions in tumors.

topics.label: Synthesis of multifactorial cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes how genetic, epigenetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors interact to drive the evolutionary development of cancer.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
